title: SPA-on-Workers deploy shape: [assets] block emitted with the elicited directory and the run_worker_first hint
asA: operator deploying a SPA on Cloudflare Workers
iWant: the generated wrangler.toml to carry an [assets] block whose directory matches my elicited answer and whose run_worker_first field carries my elicited SPA fallback choice
soThat: my SPA-on-Workers project ships with a single, ratified wrangler shape and my static assets and my auth-gated routes both behave the way Cloudflare's runtime documents them

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the operator answers assets-directory with a non-empty path P at blueprint add, when the wrangler manifest generator emits wrangler.toml, then the manifest contains exactly one [assets] block whose directory field equals P (with the leading `./` preserved when the operator answered `./P`) and the manifest carries no pages_build_output_dir field. When the operator answers assets-directory with an empty string or leaves the elicit unanswered, the manifest carries no [assets] block and no pages_build_output_dir field. Anchored to TAC-1302-deploy-cloudflare-workers-wrangler-manifest; probed by assets-manifest-scan.mjs (source-tree scan against the applied fixture wrangler.toml) with anchorAcId AC-12113-1.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an applied fixture whose operator answered assets-directory = ./dist at blueprint add
acceptanceCriteria.when: the probe module assets-manifest-scan.mjs parses the fixture wrangler.toml
acceptanceCriteria.then: the parsed structure contains an assets table whose directory string equals ./dist and no top-level pages_build_output_dir key; the probe returns verdict pass

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the operator answers run-worker-first with true alongside a non-empty assets-directory, when the manifest is generated, then the [assets] block carries run_worker_first = true. Given the operator answers run-worker-first with false or leaves it unanswered, when the manifest is generated, then the [assets] block does NOT carry a run_worker_first key (Cloudflare's runtime treats the absent field as the default asset-lookup-first shape). Anchored to TAC-1302; probed by assets-manifest-scan.mjs with anchorAcId AC-12113-1 (the same module surfaces both facets of the shape).
acceptanceCriteria.given: an applied fixture whose operator answered assets-directory = ./dist and run-worker-first = true
acceptanceCriteria.when: the probe module parses the fixture wrangler.toml
acceptanceCriteria.then: the parsed [assets] table carries run_worker_first equal to true; when the fixture is switched with SIMULATE_EMPTY_ASSETS=true the run_worker_first field is absent (the whole [assets] block is absent) and the probe still returns verdict pass because the bare-Worker shape is legal

acceptanceCriteria.description: Empty assets-directory keeps the bare-Worker shape. Given the elicited assets-directory answered as the empty string, when the deploy adapter renders the wrangler manifest, then no [assets] block is emitted (the file has no assets header), no static-asset probe fires, and the deploy runs as a bare Worker; a mutation SIMULATE_UNWANTED_ASSETS_BLOCK=true forces an [assets] block into the generated manifest and the ship gate FAILS naming the unwanted block.
acceptanceCriteria.given: assets-directory answered as the empty string
acceptanceCriteria.when: the deploy adapter renders the wrangler manifest
acceptanceCriteria.then: no [assets] block is emitted; the deploy runs as a bare Worker; the unwanted-block mutation FAILS the ship gate

acceptanceCriteria.description: Run Worker first array-of-patterns form. Given the operator answers run-worker-first with a JSON array literal such as ["/api/*", "!/api/docs/*"] alongside a non-empty assets-directory, when the wrangler manifest is generated, then the emitted [assets] block carries `run_worker_first = ["/api/*", "!/api/docs/*"]` verbatim; a deployed request to /api/orders reaches the Worker fetch handler before asset lookup, a deployed request to /api/docs/openapi.json falls back to the static-asset pipeline (negative pattern precedence), and an answer of more than 100 entries refuses at load with tooManyRunWorkerFirstPatterns naming the vendor's 100-entry cap.
acceptanceCriteria.given: run-worker-first answered as a JSON array of route patterns alongside a non-empty assets-directory
acceptanceCriteria.when: the wrangler manifest is generated and the applied Worker deploys
acceptanceCriteria.then: the [assets] block carries `run_worker_first = ["/api/*", "!/api/docs/*"]`; a request to /api/orders hits the Worker first; a request to /api/docs/openapi.json hits the static-asset pipeline first; over-100 entries refuse with tooManyRunWorkerFirstPatterns
